findings.title: Ingredients column mislabels non-food products
findings.problem: The required table column is named 'Ingredients' although the catalog is mostly toys, so the label misstates what the cell holds and the Ingredients cell is defined as materials and claims.
findings.fix: Rename the column to 'Materials & claims' so the header matches the content for toys and other non-food items.

findings.title: No fairness or self-preference rule for recommendations
findings.problem: Nothing in the system prompt sets a fairness, diversity or anti-self-preference rule for the ordering of recommended products, which the Limited-risk recommendation use case and NIST AI RMF call for; the only ordering rule is 'best fit first' and 'no placement is paid for'.
findings.fix: Add a short ranking-fairness rule to system_prompt.md stating the ordering criteria and that no product is promoted for reasons outside the shopper's stated limits and cited evidence.

findings.title: No rule on users under 18 or on data from minors
findings.problem: The only age rule covers children under three; nothing in system_prompt.md says how to handle a self-declared minor using the voice assistant or how to avoid collecting a child's data.
findings.fix: Add an age-of-user clause to the Personal details section of system_prompt.md covering minors, with a no-collection rule.

findings.title: Planner live-web rule conflicts with code search rule
findings.problem: The Planner allows the live web only for what the catalog cannot know, while the Search rule has the live web searched whenever the catalog has nothing suitable, leaving the trigger ambiguous.
findings.proof: the live web only for what the catalog cannot know
findings.fix: Merge both rules into one trigger in the Pipeline section and reference it from the Search bullet.

findings.title: Schema budget loosening contradicts 'budget stays the limit'
findings.problem: The rag.search loosening order can raise or remove the budget, while the system prompt says the budget stays the limit when the shopper invites going over it; the two rules disagree on whether the budget can silently change.
findings.proof: the budget raised by 25%, the budget removed
findings.fix: State in the rag.search description that a stated budget is never loosened and that the reply must name any product that misses it.

findings.title: Speech confidence has no defined trigger for the unclear-recording reply
findings.problem: The fixed reply for an unclear recording exists, but no rule in system_prompt.md says which speech confidence level triggers it or whether a low-confidence transcript is still routed.
findings.fix: Add a one-line rule in the Pipeline section giving a confidence threshold that selects recording unclear and the action when it is not met.

findings.title: rag.search description repeats catalog statistics
findings.problem: The rag.search description opens with corpus size and snapshot facts that also appear in the knowledge file, adding tokens to every call without changing the tool's behaviour.
findings.proof: Amazon Product Dataset 2020; 9,740 products; listings and prices are a January 2020 snapshot
findings.fix: Delete the corpus statistics from the tool description and keep the January 2020 price caveat as a short clause.

findings.title: Web listings cannot supply materials for the Ingredients column
findings.problem: The context does not tell the Answerer that web shopping results carry no materials, so a model may fill the materials cell for a web-only product from memory instead of writing 'not stated'.
findings.proof: Listings carry no description, so they do not say what a product is made of or whether it is in stock.
findings.fix: Add to the Grounding bullet in system_prompt.md that a web-only product's materials cell reads 'not stated' unless a web snippet states them.

findings.title: No fallback if the server's injection flagging fails
findings.problem: All injection defence depends on the MCP server removing instruction-like text, and nothing in the context says what the agents do if the server does not flag or remove such text.
findings.fix: Add a rule to the Untrusted text bullet that any unflagged instruction-like string in a tool result is dropped by the Critic before the draft is checked.

findings.title: Unused fixed reply 'calm' inflates agent context
findings.problem: The fixed reply 'calm' is not referenced by id anywhere in system_prompt.md, so it is dead context for the agents.
findings.proof: - calm: I'd like to keep this about your shopping.
findings.fix: Remove the calm entry from fixed_replies.md or add it to the Router's id list with a stated trigger.

findings.title: Speech-stage recording replies sent to agents
findings.problem: The three recording replies are produced by the local speech stage, not by any model, yet they are included in the agent context file.
findings.proof: - recording empty: I didn't hear anything. Hold the button and tell me what you are looking for.
findings.fix: Move the recording entries to the speech-stage configuration and drop them from the agent-facing fixed_replies.md.

findings.title: Personal-details rule stated twice
findings.problem: The personal-details rule is stated in the Enforced by code section and again in the Safety policy, repeating the same instruction in the prompt.
findings.proof: Names, addresses, e-mail addresses, phone, card and ID numbers are not needed to shop.
findings.fix: Keep one statement of the personal-details rule and reference it from the other section.

context_engineering.summary: The context is well structured, with strong grounding, injection separation and precedence, but it has missing recommendation-fairness and minor-user rules, one live-web and one budget rule conflict, and repeated and unused text that can be trimmed.

metadata.role: voice shopping assistant for product discovery (recommends and compares products; it cannot buy, change or access anything)
metadata.business_case: A shopper speaks or types a request. The assistant searches a private product catalog (rag.search) and a live web search API (web.search) through one MCP server, then answers with a spoken summary of at most 15 seconds and an on-screen comparison table with citations. It has no accounts, no orders, no payments and no personal records; both tools are read-only.
metadata.goal: Recommend up to three products that fit what the shopper asked for, state only what the retrieved evidence states, cite a source for every product, keep the spoken reply short, refuse unsafe requests, and stay within product discovery.
